title: Ja'Marr Chase's "screaming" at halftime helped spark Bengals turnaround

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ja'Marr Chase's "screaming" at halftime helped spark Bengals turnaround
sources.description: The Bengals' performance in the first half of Sunday's game against the Ravens left wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase in a foul mood.
